blocks.text: Join us every Tuesday at 9 am for a guided tour of Kingdom Heights Preparatory School with our Head of School, Dr. Rachel Ballard, PhD. Explore our newly renovated K2–12th grade campus - including a state-of-the-art performing arts center, secure facilities, and athletic fields - housed in the historic Butler High School.

items.title: SCHEDULE A TOUR
items.text: Join us on a Tuesday at 9:00 AM to experience Kingdom Heights in action. Meet our team, explore our campus, and discover what makes our approach to Christian education different.

items.title: APPLY ONLINE
items.text: Complete our online application and submit the required documents. Our admissions team will guide you through each step of the process.

items.title: STUDENT ASSESSMENT
items.text: Students participate in an age-appropriate assessment to help us understand their academic readiness and identify how we can best support their growth.

items.title: FAMILY INTERVIEW
items.text: We believe education is a partnership. During the family interview, you will meet with school leaders to discuss your goals, ask questions, and ensure Kingdom Heights is the right fit for your family.

blocks.text: We would love to schedule a time to connect and answer any questions you may have. Please fill out the form below as a first step.
We offer campus wide tours every Tuesday at 9:00 AM. You can also reach us at: admissions@khroyals.com or 256-210-1343 .

items.title: ACADEMICALLY PREPARED
items.text: Fully Accredited through COGNIA and the League of Christian Schools

items.title: GROWTH ON AND OFF THE FIELD
items.text: Character is formed through teamwork, leadership, and responsibility

items.title: SPACIOUS, BEAUTIFUL LEARNING ENVIRONMENT
items.text: Our expansive campus inside the beautifully renovated historic Butler High School gives students room to grow

items.title: CREATIVE & HANDS ON
items.text: Learning comes alive through movement, creativity, and exploration.

items.title: CLASSICAL AND RIGORIOUS
items.text: We are North Alabama’s only school that is a Hillsdale curriculum school.

items.title: PEACE OF MIND
items.text: Students experience joyful play in a safe, secure environment

items.title: LEARNING BEYOND THE DESK
items.text: During Royal Hour, students grow in critical thinking through creative outlets like podcasting, chess, and cooking with a professional chef.

items.title: FRIENDSHIP & BELONGING
items.text: Students build real friendships and a sense of belonging.

items.title: KNOWN AND CHALLENGED
items.text: Credentialed teachers deliver a clear, standards-based education.

items.title: SAFE AND SOUND
items.text: Student safety is a top priority.

items.title: STEM, CYBER, AND TECH
items.text: We prepare students to lead in Huntsville’s space, cyber, and technology fields.

items.title: ARTISTIC EXPRESSION
items.text: Students thrive in fine arts through music, acting, and playwriting.

items.title: BUILT FOR WORKING FAMILIES
items.text: We support busy families with dependable wrap-around care.

items.title: EARLY LEARNING PROGRAM
items.text: Our K2–K4 program launches a classical Christian education as early as age two.

items.title: CELEBRATED AND EMPOWERED
items.text: Students are celebrated here, and their gifts are intentionally cultivated.

items.title: SPIRIT-FILLED WORSHIP
items.text: Weekly chapel invites students into a beautiful, good, and faithful life with Christ.

blocks.text: Take the next step towards a transformative education with Kingdom Heights.
